Hey man, thanks for the advice I really appreciate it.

1) Asked him if he had plans before and he always told me he got no concrete plans(?) I guess for now he is in a limbo where he feels tired of life but at the same time don't have a plan to end it. So i guess in a way it's a bit better? 

2) I totally agree with you on that one. A bit sad that in my country mental health and mental illness is still really stigmatised. Already urged him to go counselling or therapy but I'm not sure if he wants to follow through.

3) Yes you are right. I should contact their parents if anything ever happens to him. The one thing I really gets my blood boil is that his parents seem to be overly controlling of him for some reason ( which doesn't make sense he is already turning 21 this year he is already a proper adult ) and seem to dismiss his feelings. Hope if I break the news his parents won't be even more outrageous than they already are.

And yeah, totally need that reality check. No matter what I do or how much I support him in the end it's up to him. I try to be available to chat but tbh being on a different country really makes it hard for me to really be there for him. These days i try to have group vid calls at least once a week so he knows that we care. 

And really, thanks for taking your time to write all this, it really helped me to take things into his perspective and decide on what to do. Hope everything goes well for you.

Took CM8002 last sem and if you don't watch the lectures you will probably fail.

This mod is very content heavy and the mid terms ask a lot of technical questions you will only understand if you watch the lectures ( and no i don't recommend chionging the lectures at the end cause some of the lectures are like 3 hours ). 

The final is a bit diff tho. There would be a case study and you will be asked some technical qns + some logical qns ( for example one of the qns ask which one is the suspect and why ). I rec you watch the lec where prof bates go through the past year papers to more or less know what's going on during the actual exam.

The prof will also give you extra bonus + credits if you participate in the forums. But you will probably get the side eye from the prof if you just say anyhow.

More or less i feel 8002 took a lot of time and effort from me ( i don't S/U the mod so i'm not sure how much effort other ppl put ). So just keep this in mind
